_comment: RESEARCH ONLY. One line per occurrence of a question or limb AT A SITTING. raw_stem preserves historical wording exactly as the source printed it and is never modernised; normalized_stem is derived and is for fingerprinting only. An occurrence is NOT a family; different sittings are never collapsed. Items of the official DG Shipping question bank are NOT occurrences - they are undated ancestors and live in OFFICIAL_BANK_ITEMS.json - because counting them here would inflate frequency_known, which counts sittings and nothing else.

_limb_kind_enum.SOURCE_LIMB_CONFIRMED: label matches a printed subpart label in the paper's spec
_limb_kind_enum.SOURCE_LIMB_ASSERTED: the source paper prints limbs but the spec's subparts array does not carry labels; the limb is read off the printed stem
_limb_kind_enum.ANALYTICAL_SEGMENT: an unlabelled sentence or clause of a single-limb question, isolated by MIW for comparison only - the paper prints no such division
_limb_kind_enum.AUTHORING_SCAFFOLD: an MIW authoring construct (framing/intro/main/closing/head N/dN). NEVER a recurrence key.
_limb_kind_enum.WHOLE_QUESTION: no limb; the whole question is the unit

schema_change_note: v2 adds limb_kind, official_bank_ancestor and splits date_confidence away from text_similarity_confidence and source_confidence. v1's single 'confidence' field conflated all three and is removed.
